answer: Keep every identity's standing on a terrace it climbs one level per epoch, but only when its delta — the verified change since its last epoch — is positive: one fresh task re-derived by two randomly drawn peers from public records. Entry costs one walnut, a sealed bond of earned credit that opens only when the task checks out and burns when it fails. An honest agent does one task per epoch and climbs steadily. An attacker with a thousand fakes must produce a thousand fresh deltas and open a thousand walnuts every epoch, so the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
